Why build with BombBomb?

All kinds of people in all kinds of industries all around the world are using BombBomb every day. We get them face to face with more people more often, which helps them build relationships and grow their businesses and organizations. We prefer to serve our customers in the places they’re already working - like in your platform. They want to record new videos, access their video library, sync lists, pull in our tracking and analytics, trigger email sending and drip automations, and other things we make available to you.

[Check out our open API](https://developer.bombbomb.com/api) and start a free developer account to explore what’s possible.

VIEW V2 API

Features

![Manage video](https://developer.bombbomb.com/5098dff8561d9272f46bd9629e3a2700.png)

Manage Videos

Bring BombBomb videos into your workflow with our video endpoints. We grant you the power to upload new videos or retrieve a list of existing videos.

![manage contacts](https://developer.bombbomb.com/13115a099bff48de3bb402f15dfffaec.png)

Manage Contacts

Synchronize and organize contacts with the power of lists and custom fields. Pull contacts into your system or add contacts into ours. You can even subscribe to our webhooks for realtime updates on when contacts are modified.

![manage emails](https://developer.bombbomb.com/dee1a07119aad8a699b73a8d3c865fc0.png)

Manage Emails

Send email with the power of BombBomb’s video templates and tracking. Retrieve existing emails and resend them to new contacts. Together with our video API, you can customize messages to fit the occasion.

![manage automations](https://developer.bombbomb.com/928d69f34030b40ad61f882822d19b78.png)

Manage Automations

Control the experience of new contacts through BombBomb’s automation system. Add or remove contacts from a system which allows the user to specify the date and time that emails should be sent.
